svg.title: Read the two certificate directives — instructional mockup
svg.desc: Step-specific guided recreation. Not a genuine screenshot or live result.
svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Application server (TLS-APP01) · RHEL 9 Bash terminal · learner@10.90.0.10
COMMAND / FILE CONTENT TO ENTER — PRESERVE CASE
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
Existing HTTPS sites print file paths; the fresh lab can return no lines and grep exit status 1.
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. Paste the grep command below exactly; the backslash continues the same command on the next line.
2. For an existing HTTPS site, record ssl_certificate and ssl_certificate_key from the correct server
block. Ignore commented lines until you confirm them in nginx -T.
3. For our fresh lab, no matches is expected. Record planned paths
/etc/pki/tls/certs/app-v1-fullchain.pem and /etc/pki/tls/private/app-v1.key. They will be created later.
4. Do not print the private key. Seeing its path is enough to locate it.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
